card.name: Severe before organ-failure conditions in lists
card.fires_on: The word "severe" or a comma inside a list of underlying conditions, just before heart failure, renal impairment or liver disease. It appears in warnings about patients at risk.

modes.label: Severe in condition lists
modes.description: The word "severe" sits between list items and a following organ-failure condition.
modes.example: chronic kidney disease,<< severe>> congestive heart failure, or volume depletion

modes.label: Comma in condition lists
modes.description: A comma between listed conditions such as ascites, heart failure and liver disease.
modes.example: prior history of ascites<<,>> variceal bleeding, encephal

modes.label: Partway through a condition term
modes.description: Part of a condition phrase such as uncompensated heart failure.

card.writes: It adds little clear output; the promoted tokens (shock and similar) hint at severe circulatory failure terms.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a list of risk conditions where another serious organ-failure condition is about to be named.
